g.text: Like a brand-new transistor, a new photonic

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: device may not fit an existing process flow

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: at first — so a natural pipeline forms.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Takeaway: device engineering drove perhaps 90% of the work; Si Mach-Zehnder modulators are already competitive for many applications,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: and Ge photodiodes on technical merits; new devices move from specialty processes into integrated platforms.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Source: book Sec. 1.5 and 1.5.1, p. 17 (file.md l.1158-1169). Verdicts are qualitative; no dB, Gb/s or efficiency values are given there or shown here.
